# Data Directory

This directory contains generated observation data in JSON format.

## Generated Files

Files are automatically generated by `scripts/generate_fake_data.py` and saved here:
- `observations_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json` - Auto-generated timestamped files
- Custom filenames when using `--save-json` flag

## Usage

Generate data:
```bash
python scripts/generate_fake_data.py --count 100 --save-json my_data.json
```

Load existing data:
```bash
python scripts/generate_fake_data.py --load-json data/my_data.json
```

## Git Ignore

All `.json` files in this directory are ignored by git to avoid committing large datasets.
